description.value: Mediterranean Grill has been serving authentic Mediterranean and Persian cuisine in Vancouver's West End since 1999, making it one of the longest-running restaurants in the neighbourhood. The menu spans kabobs, shawarma, Persian stews (including Ghormeh Sabzi and Gheymeh), falafel, dolmades, and more, with both meat and vegetarian options. The Denman Street location near Stanley Park makes it a convenient stop for cyclists coming off the seawall, with both indoor and outdoor seating available.
